This PEP status makes all financial dealings with Epstein subject to enhanced due diligence requirements - which Deutsche Bank and Israeli banks repeatedly flagged.

Wexner Foundation paid Ehud Barak .3 million between 2004-2006, described as payment for two research papers — one on Israeli-Palestinian conflict, one on leadership. Barak only completed one paper. Foundation justified full payment saying completed work was sufficient. Barak was a private citizen at the time. This creates a direct financial link: Wexner Foundation -> Barak -> Epstein (Barak's 444-email correspondent and Carbyne business partner). Epstein served as de facto CFO of Wexner family office and approved foundation grants during this exact period (2004-2006).

ACRIS reveals Barak's full NYC real estate footprint: (1) Manhattan Club timeshare at 200 W 56th St bought May 2007 for 13K, sold Sep 2019 for 100 (post-Epstein arrest); (2) 15 Hubert St (Tribeca) purchased Feb 2017 for 3.1M with Yadin Rozov and Benjamin Ensminger-Law, sold Mar 2018 for 2.57M; (3) 245 W 99th St (Ariel West condo) purchased Apr 2025 for 3.7M with Cecile Zwiebach, 2.96M Wells Fargo mortgage plus 335K additional mortgage. His address 820 West End Ave appears in 2017-2018 transactions.
